nodes.label: RIPK1
props: Cell death protein RIP; Receptor-interacting protein 1

Serine-threonine kinase which is a key regulator of TNF-mediated apoptosis, necroptosis and inflammatory pathways. Exhibits kinase activity-dependent functions that regulate cell death and kinase-independent scaffold functions regulating inflammatory signaling and cell survival.

nodes.label: TRAF2
props: E3 ubiquitin-protein ligase TRAF2; RING-type E3 ubiquitin transferase TRAF2; Tumor necrosis factor type 2 receptor-associated protein 3

E3 ubiquitin-protein ligase that regulates activation of NF-kappa-B and JNK and plays a central role in the regulation of cell survival and apoptosis. Catalyzes 'Lys-63'-linked ubiquitination of target proteins, such as BIRC3, IKBKE, MLST8, RIPK1 and TICAM1.

nodes.label: TRADD
props: Tumor necrosis factor receptor type 1-associated DEATH domain protein

Adapter molecule for TNFRSF1A/TNFR1 that specifically associates with the cytoplasmic domain of activated TNFRSF1A/TNFR1 mediating its interaction with FADD. Overexpression of TRADD leads to two major TNF-induced responses, apoptosis and activation of NF-kappa-B.
